name: velocut
description: Direct the live Velocut 3D editor from Codex with editable scenes and visual feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Model and direct scenes in your live editor.
interface.longDescription: Use the model in your Codex conversation to create editable 3D scenes, import GLB assets, arrange objects and lights, direct cameras, and inspect real rendered images. Pairs to a local Velocut editor; no separate model API key.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my local Velocut editor.
Build a cafe scene with tables and warm lighting.
Inspect my scene and improve its camera composition.
